Available in three sizes (toy, miniature, and standard) and two varieties (hairless and coated), the Xolo is both alert and loyal. With a thoughtful, intelligent face and a wrinkled forehead when deep in thought, the Xolo is as strong and rugged as it is graceful and elegant.
